items.title: Is AI creating the very threats they're now hired to fight?
items.summary:
Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on CrowdStrike (CRWD) announcing a "kill switch" for AI agents, making the stock jump as demand for cybersecurity grows. 

Today's panel includes Drew Pettit, Chief Investment Strategist at Roundhill Investments; Mario Tufano, Senior Portfolio Manager at CS McKee; Emily Peck, Markets Reporter at Axios; and Al Root, Associate Editor at Barron's.

items.title: CrowdStrike gives companies a 'kill switch' as bots go off script

items.title: AI Server Backlog Could Reshape The Dell Stock Story

items.title: CrowdStrike Is Spending $495 Million to Police AI Agents
items.summary: CrowdStrike just signed two secret-priced deals at its Barcelona conference and flipped a new switch that lets humans shut down rogue AI agents cold. Whether the platform it is assembling will outrun rival offerings before the market decides who wins is now the question hanging over the stock.
